subject: BCP/DR evidence for SIG onboarding — RTO/RPO snapshot and witness
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pinecrestpayments.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: procure@pinecrestpayments.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BCP evidence required for SIG — RTO/RPO details

Hi Chloe,

We're working through the SIG intake and Pinecrest needs a short packet that demonstrates Redwood's recovery characteristics for the hosted offering. Specifically the reviewer asked for: 
- A matrix showing RTO/RPO by failure domain (region, instance, KV cache loss)
- A short excerpt of the runbook for warm-start / failover
- Measured KV cache warm times (cold, warm-warm, and warm) for typical workloads
- Confirmation of the witness/test window so we can schedule a live walkthrough in early April

Can you confirm what you can share directly and whether a redacted runbook excerpt is acceptable? Procurement is on a bit of a deadline, so a one-week turnaround would help.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Price
Senior Risk Manager | Pinecrest Payments
jordan.price@pinecrestpayments.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BCP evidence required for SIG — RTO/RPO details

Neha / Karthik — forwarding Pinecrest request below. Procurement wants a compact bundle for SIG review: RTO/RPO matrix, runbook excerpt (redacted), and cache warm timings. Jordan is asking for a live witness session early next week (Apr 1–3).

Ask: can you assemble the artifacts below and confirm whether we need any further approvals to share the runbook snippet? If we can provide a redacted PDF and the RTO/RPO XLSX by EOD Thursday (3/31) that should keep procurement on schedule.

Items requested (from Pinecrest):
- RTO/RPO matrix by failure domain
- Runbook excerpt for warm-start/failover (redacted acceptable)
- KV cache warm timing samples (CSV)
- Short statement mapping these artifacts to SOC 2 controls / SIG questions (1 paragraph)

I can own sending the packet and coordinating the Calendly for a 30-min witness slot. Ben — looping you in for commercial context; they might ask about SLA wording.

Thanks,
Chloe
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BCP evidence required for SIG — RTO/RPO details

Hi Chloe / Ben —

We can provide the following artifacts:
1) rto_rpo_matrix.xlsx (attached) — includes rows for region failover, single-node loss, DB restore, and KV cache loss with measured/target values and brief notes on mitigation. RTO targets are: region failover 15m (auto-route + DNS), instance replacement 3m, DB point-in-time restore 2h (for warm standby we rely on replica promotion), KV cache replay 90s (warm), 8m (cold). RPOs are listed per domain.

2) bcp-runbook-extract.pdf (attached) — redacted for on-call emails, internal hostnames, and playbook tokens. This excerpt shows the failover steps, escalation matrix, and rollback criteria. Legal okayed the redactions; no NDAs required for this level of detail.

3) warm-cache-timings.csv (attached) — three sample runs from our last warm-start exercises; includes token counts and millisecond timings. Note: timings are measured on p4d-equivalent hardware under a 512-token context.

4) Control mapping (one-paragraph) — "The provided RTO/RPO matrix and runbook excerpt demonstrate alignment with CC6.1/CC7.3 (incident response & continuity) in our SOC 2 framework; cache warm timings and warm-start steps illustrate recovery metrics relied on by SLAs."

Internal note: remove any references to internal test cluster IDs before sending externally. I've attached the artifacts to this thread for Chloe to send.

- Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BCP evidence required for SIG — RTO/RPO details

Chloe — quick security attestation and witness plan:
- The runbook excerpt is fine to share redacted as Neha described. Please ensure we scrub any SSH fingerprints and internal ticket links.
- For the live witness, we recommend a 30-min session where we (Karthik / Neha) walk through the runbook steps, show the CSV timings, and answer SIG control questions. Proposed windows: Thu Apr 1 10:00–12:00 PT or Fri Apr 2 14:00–16:00 PT. I'll be present for the walkthrough to answer SIG-specific control questions.

Also confirm whether Pinecrest requires a signed attestation. If so, we can provide a short attestation letter signed by our Head of Security.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@pinecrestpayments.com>
Cc: procure@pinecrestpayments.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BCP/DR evidence for SIG onboarding — RTO/RPO snapshot and witness

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the request. Attached are the compact materials we discussed: rto_rpo_matrix.xlsx, bcp-runbook-extract.pdf (redacted), and warm-cache-timings.csv. Per Karthik and Neha, internal identifiers have been removed.

We can do a 30-minute live walkthrough. Please pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-witness/30min (we've proposed Apr 1 and Apr 2 windows). Karthik (Security) and Neha (Ops) will join to cover control-level questions and timing artifacts.

We can also provide a short signed attestation if Procurement needs it — let me know and I will route to our Head of Security for signature.

Next steps:
- Confirm preferred witness time via Calendly
- Confirm whether the redaction level is acceptable or if Pinecrest needs additional detail under an NDA
- Confirm if a signed attestation is required (we can turn that around within 48 hours)

Attachments: rto_rpo_matrix.xlsx; bcp-runbook-extract.pdf; warm-cache-timings.csv

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
